# testdata/

Fixtures shared across packages: `fixtures/` (recorded GitHub responses), `golden/` (HTML, SVG, Markdown, config outputs) and
`worlds/<name>/` (worlds served by `cmd/fakegithub`; the demo world for `make dev` is `worlds/demo`). Package-local fixtures stay in the
package's own `testdata/` directory. The worlds of unit 05 are in `docs/design/20-design/05-github-adapter.assets/worlds/`; copy them here with
task B-7. Keys and tokens generated by `make dev-keys` are git-ignored (see `.gitignore`).
